name: cost-waterfall
title: Run cost waterfall
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A run's cost and tokens as a cumulative waterfall, with cache savings, a live reducer, and JSON or CSV export.

meta.descriptionEs: El costo y los tokens de una corrida en una cascada acumulada, con ahorro de caché, reducer en vivo y exportación JSON o CSV.

examples.title: Expediente de ejemplo
examples.description: Precios ilustrativos. El interruptor cambia la cascada a tokens.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: 300 pasos, ocho niveles, costo 0 y costo enorme, 390 px.

api.name: run / pricing / events
api.description: Flat tree of steps. events drives useCostRun from the same starting run.

api.name: money
api.description: Intl locale and currency. fx is an integer fraction from the pricing currency.

api.name: mode / collapsed / openId / waterfallOpen
api.description: Cost or tokens, folded parents, the open payload, and the waterfall disclosure.

api.name: labels
api.description: English is the default. costWaterfallLabelsEs is es-MX.

api.name: loading / error / onRetry
api.description: Skeleton, or an alert with a retry when the host cannot read the run.

docs: Clean-room reading of a public behavior description. Affect UI Cost Waterfall is Pro (https://www.affectui.com/components/cost-waterfall) and was not purchased or fetched. The public repo is MIT and does not contain this item. No Affect source, sample data, icons, or assets were copied. Prices in the demo are marked as examples. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite badge, button, card, empty, scroll-area, separator, skeleton, segmented-control, or csv. The item ships no theme and no cssVars. The pure core is cost-waterfall-core.
